plugins.name: email-dashboard
plugins.description: A local dashboard for an agent-run email routine. Triages your mail, files the money trail, and surfaces only what earned your attention - with a sandboxed reader that blocks every tracking pixel, per-sender link profiles that flag a trusted sender writing from somewhere new, and panels that alarm by seeing nothing (a biller that went quiet, a notice arriving for the fifth time).
